action.old_text: raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
action.new_text:
# Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or logp_with_result.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("logp_with_result must be a 2D numpy array")
    if not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or logp_call_only.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("logp_call_only must be a 2D numpy array")
    if not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray) or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("logp_no_call must be a 2D numpy array")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    if logp_with_result.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
    if np.any(logp_with_result > 0) or np.any(logp_call_only > 0) or np.any(logp_no_call > 0):
        raise ValueError("All log probabilities must be nonpositive")
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call)):
        raise ValueError("All log probabilities must be finite")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0 or isinstance(tau_filter, (bool, np.bool_)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative threshold, not a boolean")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    with_score = np.average(logp_with_result, weights=norm_weights, axis=1)
    call_score = np.average(logp_call_only, weights=norm_weights, axis=1)
    no_score = np.average(logp_no_call, weights=norm_weights, axis=1)

    best_alt = np.maximum(call_score, no_score)
    margin = with_score - best_alt
    keep = margin > tau_filter

    return keep, margin
